name: Discern Lycanthrope
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of fur or flesh from a lycanthrope), DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target s one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Each round you concentrate on one subject, who must be within range.

You know if the subject is a lycanthrope or not, regardless of its current shape (humanoid, hybrid, or animal). You can determine the exact type of lycanthrope with a DC 20 Knowledge (local) check.

Each round you may concentrate on a different subject.
